sources.title: [1301.3666] Zero-Shot Learning Through Cross-Modal Transfer
sources.snippet: This work introduces a model that can recognize objects in images even if no training data is available for the objects. The only necessary knowledge about the unseen categories comes from unsupervised large text corpora.
